# The Exchange-type form landing stages controls before state behavior

The landing adds Graph/EWS choices, labeled username/authentication fields, default/custom OAuth controls, helper resources and scoped styling. Its owned widget still has empty setState and captureState methods, and conditional Tenant/App visibility is explicitly deferred in discussion. Accepted source later implements config capture; that later behavior is separate. The selected markup adopts the corrected authentication id and removes an obsolete aria-labelledby reference, but no completed account flow, native accessibility or runtime result is established.

Scope: Account Hub Exchange type form presentation phase.
